_comment: Source for app/assets/catalog/catalog.json (MDL-01). Edit here, then build + sign (tools/model-catalog/README.md). Fields starting with '_' are provenance notes and are not copied into the catalog. Primary URLs use the placeholder host models.vaultvoice.example until the CDN is provisioned (PRODUCT-DECISION, ADR-MDL-01); the Hugging Face URLs are mirrors pinned to a repo revision.

models._provenance: 2026-10-12: downloaded from the pinned HF revision with curl; size and sha256 computed locally (shasum -a 256) and equal to the HF LFS oid.

2026-10-12: size and sha256 = HF LFS metadata (api/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/<rev>, lfs.oid is the SHA-256 of the file). Local re-hash by download was blocked by the network proxy; re-verify with `catalog.py hash` (follow-up in MDL-01).
